brief.zh: 用视差搜索元件。噪声图和细柱图都要算对（与真实视差相差不超过 1、错的像素不多）。
brief.en: Use the Disparity search part. Get both the noisy images and the thin-bar image right (within 1 of the true disparity, with few wrong pixels).

hint.zh: 窗口小，噪声会骗过匹配；窗口大，细东西会被周围的背景淹没。
hint.en: With a small window, noise fools the matching; with a large one, thin things drown in the surrounding background.

after.zh: 没有对所有图都最好的窗口：大窗口抗噪但抹掉细节，小窗口保细节但怕噪声。很多视觉问题都是这种权衡。
after.en: No window is best for every image: a large window resists noise but wipes out detail; a small one keeps detail but is vulnerable to noise. Many vision problems involve this kind of trade-off.

t.zh: <level-ref to="7-1"></level-ref>搭的匹配，现在打包成了元件<part-ref to="disparity"></part-ref>。它只有一个参数：窗口，也就是比较时围着每格取多大一块，两张图按整块来比。
t.en: The matching you built in <level-ref to="7-1"></level-ref> is now packed into the <part-ref to="disparity"></part-ref> part. It has a single parameter: the window, which is how big a patch to take around each pixel when comparing; the two images are compared patch by patch.

t.zh: 真实的立体相机也要挑这个大小。街景里有大片的墙，也有细细的电线杆和栏杆；光线暗时，照片上满是噪点。同一台相机，要对付所有这些。
t.en: Real stereo cameras have to pick this size too. A street scene has large stretches of wall, but also thin power poles and railings; in dim light the photos are full of noise. The same camera has to cope with all of it.

t.zh: 三组测试：有噪声的方块、一根细柱、一个更近的噪声方块。同一个窗口要三组都算对：和真实视差差不超过 1，错的格子不多。
t.en: Three test sets: a noisy square, a thin pillar, and a closer noisy square. A single window must get all three right: within 1 of the true disparity, with only a few wrong pixels.

caption.zh: 细柱：视差图里也只是一根细柱
caption.en: The thin pillar: in the disparity map it is still just a thin pillar

t.zh: 这一关只给这一个元件，你要定的是窗口。动手前想一想：窗口变大，比较时多得到了什么，又丢掉了什么？
t.en: This level gives you only this one part; what you decide is the window. Before you start, think: when the window grows, what does the comparison gain, and what does it lose?
